title: Carriage Tariff of the Northbeam Returns and Restocking Schedules: Routes, Labels and Collection Charges
content:
Nine figures govern how an item comes back on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule and who pays for the journey. They are published schedule by schedule below.

## Routes and who pays

| Return schedule | Ways the item may come back | Who pays to bring it back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | in-store drop-off or prepaid label | the customer unless the item is defective |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | in-store drop-off, prepaid label or carrier pickup | the retailer |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | carrier pickup only | the retailer |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | in-store drop-off only | the customer |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | not applicable, the line is final sale | not applicable |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | freight collection or carrier pickup | the retailer under the contract |

## Collection charges, label life and notice

The carrier collection fee is the fee for a carrier collection from the address. The freight collection fee is the fee for a freight collection of a palletised return. Label validity days are the days a prepaid return label stays usable from the day it is issued. Collection lead days are the days of notice needed to book a collection. The reschedule limit is the number of times a collection may be moved at the customer's request.

| Return schedule | Carrier collection fee | Freight collection fee | Label validity days | Collection lead days | Reschedule limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 14.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 14 | 3 | 2 |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 21 | 2 | 3 |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 0.00 USD | 89.00 USD | 7 | 2 | 1 |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 0.00 USD | 125.00 USD | 30 | 5 | 4 |

## Business authorisation and carriage loss

Business authorisation required means a signed authorisation from the business is needed before collection. The carrier damage liability names who carries the loss when the item is damaged on the way back.

| Return schedule | Business authorisation required | Who carries a loss on the way back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | no | the carrier where the retailer booked it, otherwise the customer |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | no | the retailer |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | no | the retailer |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | no | the customer |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | no | not applicable |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | the retailer under the contract |

**Tariff note.** Only Standard Fifteen Day Return publishes a carrier collection fee the customer pays, and only the two crew schedules, Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return and Business Contract Return Schedule, publish a freight collection fee. The remaining four schedules publish 0.00 USD in both columns.
